description: The Water Tiger in Chinese astrology: personality, Water element traits, 1962 and 2022 dates and compatibility.
answer: In Chinese astrology, the Water Tiger is the Tiger born in a Water year, one of five versions of the third animal. It combines the Tiger's courage with Water's qualities. Water Tiger years between 1924 and 2044 are 1962 and 2022. The Tiger's fixed element is Wood.

sections.heading: The Water Tiger personality
paragraphs: The Water Tiger is often described as the most thoughtful and intuitive of the Tigers. Water generates Wood in the five-element cycle, and the Tiger's fixed element is Wood, so the year stem is said to nourish the animal, softening its edges and deepening its perception. Water Tigers tend to be imaginative, empathetic and open-minded, with the Tiger's courage tempered by a capacity to sense what others need. They often communicate well and can persuade without force. The nourishing relationship gives them calm confidence, though the Tiger's restlessness may still surface as indecision, with too many options considered and a reluctance to commit once Water's sensitivity has weighed every angle.

Water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication. Descriptions associate it with wisdom, empathy and the ability to find a way around obstacles rather than through them. Water-year people are often portrayed as perceptive listeners, diplomatic and quietly persuasive, able to sense the mood of a room before anyone speaks. The element is linked with reflection and with the unseen, so it adds an inward, thoughtful layer. Its shadow, in most readings, is drift: indecision, secrecy, and a tendency to take on the shape of whoever is nearby.

sections.heading: Water Tiger at work and in love
paragraphs: At work, Water is usually associated with communication, strategy and insight into people. Water-year people are often described as the ones who smooth negotiations, read what clients are really asking for and spot problems before they surface, which suits counselling, writing, diplomacy, research roles, marketing and the arts. They tend to adapt quickly to changing conditions. The traditional caution is a lack of firm boundaries: a Water stem may agree too readily, so clear goals and written commitments usually help it hold course.

Tradition paints the Water Tiger as a visionary who can sense where a field is heading before the trend has a name. Design, consultancy, international work, documentary-making and teaching are commonly named, as intuition about people and patterns gives it an edge. Flexible structures and collaborators who welcome unconventional ideas suit it; without a deadline, however, it can drift. Between two people, the Water Tiger is perceptive and kind, able to read a partner's mood from across a crowded room. It needs space to think and someone who respects sudden bursts of independence. The hitch is inconsistency: warmth one week, distance the next, which can leave the other person unsure exactly where they stand.

sections.heading: Water Tiger years and dates
paragraphs: Between 1924 and 2044 the Water Tiger years are 1962 (February 5, 1962 to January 24, 1963) and 2022 (February 1, 2022 to January 21, 2023). Because the year begins at Lunar New Year, a birthday in January or early February needs checking: in 1962 anyone born before Feb 5 is a Metal Ox, not a Water Tiger. The combination returns every sixty years, since five elements cycle through twelve animals and only meet the same pairing again after five rounds of the zodiac. Every Water Tiger year is Yang, matching the Tiger's own polarity.

Chinese almanacs call the combination Ren-Yin, joining the heavenly stem Ren to the earthly branch Yin. Births just before each new year fall in the Metal Ox year (before February 5, 1962) and the Metal Ox year (before February 1, 2022), and births in the weeks after each Water Tiger year ends belong to the Water Rabbit. The new year itself fell on a Monday in 1962 and Tuesday in 2022.

sections.heading: Growth edges and compatibility for the Water Tiger
paragraphs: Growth for the Water Tiger usually lies in decisiveness. Readings suggest that this combination can wait for perfect clarity, so setting deadlines and committing to a direction helps. Water Tigers may also absorb others' moods strongly, which makes clear boundaries important in close relationships. Creative work such as writing, music or design tends to channel their imaginative energy productively. Because they are often more sensitive than they appear, admitting when something hurts allows others to support them. When intuition and courage combine, the Water Tiger becomes a visionary who can turn insight into bold, compassionate action.

For relationships, the classical structures belong to the animal rather than the element, so the Water Tiger shares the Tiger's San He trine with the Horse and Dog (the Fire trine), its Liu He bond with the Pig, and its Liu Chong clash with the Monkey. The element adds a second layer: another Water sign shares this year element, while partners whose year element feeds Water in the generating cycle are often described as supportive.

faq.question: What years are Water Tiger years?
faq.answer: Between 1924 and 2044: 1962 (from February 5, 1962) and 2022 (from February 1, 2022). Each lasts until the day before the next Lunar New Year.

faq.question: What is the Water Tiger's element relationship?
faq.answer: The year element is Water and the Tiger's fixed element is Wood; in the five-element cycles water generates Wood. Readings use that relationship to describe how easily the two sides of the sign sit together.

faq.question: Which animals are most compatible with the Water Tiger?
faq.answer: Traditionally the Horse and Dog (San He) and the Pig (Liu He). The Monkey is the Liu Chong clash. These pairings depend on the animal, whatever the element.

faq.question: What is the Water Tiger called in the Chinese calendar?
faq.answer: Ren-Yin. In almanacs and Four Pillars charts each year is named by its heavenly stem, here the Water stem Ren, followed by its earthly branch, here Yin for the Tiger, so the name pins down both halves of the combination at once.

faq.question: How is the Water Tiger different from other Tigers?
faq.answer: All Tigers share courage, independence and magnetic energy. The Water year element changes the tone: water is the element of winter, stillness and depth, and a Water year is traditionally said to give any animal intuition, flexibility and a gift for communication.
